parsed_excerpt: p2s1: This directive carries catastrophic risk classification and must be treated as more severe than any standard tier.

expected.assertion: 'catastrophic' is not a member of the closed vocabulary. It must not be invented as a new literal and must not be silently coerced to the nearest-sounding real value ('high' or 'global_mandatory'); the field is declined (returned null / listed in declined_field_paths) so a human judgment call resolves it.

rationale: The gate's hostile half: a plausible-sounding severity word that is not in the closed set. Inventing it, or quietly substituting the nearest real value without a citation for that specific choice, are both failures this gate is built to catch.
